content.title: List of grocery stores open on Easter Sunday 2026
content.text: Millions of Americans preparing meals and gatherings for Easter Sunday may want to finalize shopping plans early, as several major retailers and grocery chains will close their doors nationwide for the occasion.Easter Sunday falls on April 5, 2026, and while it is not a federal holiday, many grocery stores are choosing to either completely close or offer reduced hours to allow employees to spend time with their families. According to reporting compiled by various publications, the closures will affect some of the most widely used grocery and big‑box supermarket chains across the U.S., while others will remain open with modified hours.Below is a breakdown of what shoppers can expect.Stock image of a supermarket aisle. | (Photo by Tom Sibley via Getty Images)Is Target Open on Easter Sunday?According to the Courier Journal, Target will be closed on Easter Sunday. All U.S. locations are scheduled to shut down for the day and resume normal business hours on Monday.The closure affects grocery sections inside Target stores, meaning shoppers will not be able to purchase food items, holiday candy, or household essentials at Target on Easter Sunday itself. Is Costco Open on Easter Sunday?Costco Wholesale warehouses are also expected to close nationwide on Easter Sunday, according to reporting by KTVU. The closure applies to both Costco warehouses and food courts, which are popular destinations for bulk holiday shopping. As a result, people are encouraged to complete their bulk-buying ahead of time. Is Trader Joe’s Open on Easter Sunday?Trader Joe’s has confirmed it will remain open on Easter Sunday, with normal operating hours, with the exception of Trader Joe’s in Portland, Maine, which will be closed on April 5. Most locations are expected to operate from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. local time, though hours may vary by store.Customers are still encouraged to check with their local branch, especially as popular holiday items often sell out quickly. Is Walmart Open on Easter Sunday?Walmart stores are expected to remain open on Easter Sunday, providing one of the most reliable last‑minute shopping options for consumers. Most locations are expected to operate under their normal business hours.Other Grocery Store ClosuresRetail Me Not has reported that several additional grocery chains will close entirely on Easter Sunday, including Aldi, Best Buy, Kohl’s, Sam’s Club, Lowe’s, and JCPenney, all of which have longstanding holiday closure policies. Consumers Are Advised To Shop Before Easter SundayWith multiple major grocery retailers closed at the same time, customers are advised to finish their shopping by Saturday evening. Stores that remain open may experience heavier foot traffic, limited stock, or shortened hours.Is This Article Fair?Select an option to vote. You can change it anytime.For those celebrating Easter, planning ahead could be the difference between a smooth holiday meal and a last‑minute scramble.
